_meta.description: Openconnector source registry for Shillinq. Sources are referenced by slug from docudesk template output-channel declarations per ADR-019, and by the 15 external-adapter families declared in ExternalAdaptersAdminController:ADAPTERS (openspec/changes/integration-config-to-openconnector). Credentials and protocol mapping are managed entirely in openconnector; Shillinq holds only the source slug reference.

sources.title: BZK SiSa Upload 2026
sources.description: Openconnector source for BZK SiSa-bijlage annual submission. Auth and protocol mapping (OAuth or PKI-cert per BZK specifiek) are openconnector-side. Shillinq references this source by slug from the sisa-bijlage-2026 docudesk template output-channel. No app-local HTTP client per ADR-019. NOTE (openspec/changes/integration-config-to-openconnector/design.md §6.1): the controller's `bzk-sisa` family entry declares `sourceSlug: 'bzk-sisa'`, one word short of this file's `bzk-sisa-upload-2026`. Neither slug was found provisioned against the live openconnector instance checked for this change (0/262 seeded sources matched either string): per the resolution recorded in design.md, this pre-existing entry's slug is kept as-is rather than renamed blind; renaming a slug nobody can yet confirm as live risks breaking a future operator's already-wired reference in either direction.

configuration.description: Connection parameters are managed in openconnector's Source admin UI. Shillinq holds this stub to register the source slug in the OR source registry on app install. Operators configure the BZK endpoint URL, authentication method (OAuth 2.0 client credentials or PKI-cert mutual TLS per BZK specifiek), and retry policy via the openconnector admin panel.

auditEvent.description: Every submission attempt triggers the sisa.submitted audit event written by the docudesk template's output-channel on response receipt.

sources.title: Digipoort / SBR
sources.description: Openconnector source for SBR/XBRL filings (BTW-aangifte, jaarrekening, CSRD pack) submitted to the Belastingdienst Digipoort WUS gateway. Auth and protocol mapping are openconnector-side. Shillinq references this source by slug from DigipoortSbrAdapterInterface's activation recipe; the log-only default (LogDigipoortSbrAdapter) keeps the filing lifecycle observable until a real binding is provisioned. No app-local HTTP client per ADR-019.

configuration.description: Connection parameters are managed in openconnector's Source admin UI. Operators configure the Digipoort WUS endpoint URL, the PKIoverheid services-certificate alias, and the SBR message-type mapping via the openconnector admin panel.

sources.title: Mollie Payments
sources.description: Openconnector source for creating deposit-payment intents (iDEAL / Bancontact / SEPA) via Mollie. Auth and protocol mapping are openconnector-side. Shillinq references this source by slug from MolliePaymentAdapterInterface's activation recipe; the log-only default keeps DepositReconciliationService's lifecycle observable until a real binding is provisioned. Inbound webhook callbacks stay verified by the fail-closed HMAC gate on the webhook controllers, never this source. No app-local HTTP client per ADR-019.

configuration.description: Connection parameters are managed in openconnector's Source admin UI. Operators configure the Mollie API endpoint, the live API key, and the webhook secret via the openconnector admin panel.

sources.title: Treasury Rates (ECB / SDMX)
sources.description: Openconnector source for fetching daily reference rates (EURIBOR-3M / SOFR / SARON / ESTR) + FX spots from ECB SDMX (or Bloomberg / Refinitiv). Auth and protocol mapping are openconnector-side. Shillinq references this source by slug from TreasuryRateAdapterInterface's activation recipe; the log-only default keeps interest-accrual + FX-revaluation aggregations observable until a real binding is provisioned. Manual IntercompanyLoan.interestRate remains the v1 fallback. No app-local HTTP client per ADR-019.

configuration.description: Connection parameters are managed in openconnector's Source admin UI. Operators configure the reference-rate provider's endpoint (ECB SDMX is free; Bloomberg / Refinitiv require a market-data subscription key) via the openconnector admin panel.

sources.title: CCM Rule Engine
sources.description: Openconnector source for delegating CCM v1 sync/async DSL evaluation to a third-party rule evaluator (or the future OpenRegister native rule engine). Auth and protocol mapping are openconnector-side. Shillinq references this source by slug from CcmRuleEngineAdapterInterface's activation recipe; the log-only default fails soft (DEFERRED, fired=false) so binding never raises a false finding until a real binding is provisioned. No app-local HTTP client per ADR-019.

configuration.description: Connection parameters are managed in openconnector's Source admin UI. Operators configure the target rule engine's endpoint (Drools, OPA, or another evaluator) and its API key via the openconnector admin panel. Leaving the `ccm-external-engine` feature flag OFF keeps the in-process v1 evaluator.

sources.title: CSRD / ESRS XBRL
sources.description: Openconnector source for EFRAG ESRS XBRL taxonomy mapping + mandatory-data-point validation + iXBRL instance build. Auth and protocol mapping are openconnector-side. Shillinq references this source by slug from CsrdEsrsXbrlAdapterInterface's activation recipe. SAFETY-CRITICAL: the log-only default's validateMandatoryDataPoints always returns VALIDATION_BLOCKED so an unvalidated CSRD report cannot slip past EFRAG IG-3 before a real binding is provisioned. No app-local HTTP client per ADR-019.

configuration.description: Connection parameters are managed in openconnector's Source admin UI. Operators configure the EFRAG taxonomy version (2024-01 baseline at v1) and the XBRL instance-build service endpoint via the openconnector admin panel.

sources.title: Deposit Payment lifecycle
sources.description: Openconnector source for the lifecycle layer sitting one layer above the Mollie source: the lifecycle code never sees a Mollie vs. Stripe branch, only the projected DepositPayment state. Auth and protocol mapping are openconnector-side, and per DepositPaymentAdapterInterface's activation recipe this source delegates to `mollie-payments` under the hood. The log-only default returns pending / PAYMENT_DEFERRED with dormant=true so DepositReconciliationService:pollPending must inspect the dormant flag before advancing. No app-local HTTP client per ADR-019.

configuration.description: Connection parameters are managed in openconnector's Source admin UI. Bind the Mollie source first (see the `mollie-payments` entry above); this source's provider mapping is then configured via the openconnector admin panel.
